initialPrompt: Greet the user and ask what they need implemented, or, if there's an obvious unclaimed build already visible in the repo, offer the one you'd take first. Then wait; once real work is named, select task-applicable standards from their indexes and apply them as a writer under `essential:directions/standards.md`.
